name: v33 Shared Coordinate Selection Diagnostic
interpretation: Retrospective exploratory diagnostic on previously viewed articles; no new quality validation
compute_scope: CPU artifact analysis only; no CUDA calls, model forwards, GPTQ, PPL, or whole-model quantization

inherits.article_unit: 16 complete 2048-token WT2 train articles per search or held group; no token splitting
inherits.prefix: fixed v18 M2 quantized prefix, identical v23/v24 cached inputs for all four arms

scoring.target: same original unquantized reference X_FP16.float()@W_FP16.float().T; bias cancels
scoring.input_chunk: 2 complete documents = 4096 tokens; 4 fixed output rows; FP32 GEMM and FP64 squared-sum accumulation
scoring.normalization: divide by 16*2048 tokens for each row
scoring.selection: argmin on search MSE over the original 10 alphas; exact ties choose larger alpha
scoring.held_use: score only G10 alpha1 and G11 search-selected row candidates after selection lock
scoring.baseline: reused v24/v31 original scalar10 search and held scores with exact source check
scoring.Qeff: optional diagnostic Qprime*D^-1 in FP32 only; not a packable original G128 weight

selection_unit: one target x split, with four fixed output rows sharing one coordinate choice D

coordinate_choices.identity: D=I, original-coordinate v24/v32 scalar10 candidate bank
coordinate_choices.fixed: the already frozen v32 target x split activation-derived D; no new D or strength search

selection_rule.per_coordinate_per_row: argmin over the original 10 alpha search MSE values; exact ties choose larger alpha
selection_rule.coordinate_score: sum over the four fixed rows of per-row minimum search MSE * 32768 tokens
selection_rule.coordinate_choice: choose the smaller coordinate score; exact equality selects D=I with zero tolerance
selection_rule.data_access: selection process consumes search_mse values only; no held score values are read before SEARCH_SELECTION_LOCK.json is written
selection_rule.expected_identity_inclusion: shared minimum search score must be <= G01 sum because D=I arm is in the candidate set

held_analysis.timing: separate command after frozen search choices and lock are written
held_analysis.baseline: v32 G01 held result for each row
held_analysis.selected_fixed: v32 G11 held result at the already selected fixed D row alpha
held_analysis.selected_identity: v32 G01 held result at the already selected identity-coordinate row alpha
held_analysis.epsilon: v32/v24 frozen per-row repeat-noise epsilon; no new tolerance
held_analysis.severe_regression_threshold: strictly worse than -10% relative to G01, regardless of WTL epsilon
held_analysis.aggregation: four-row SSE within each target x split; row-wise diagnostics remain paired units
